text:
Maya: Hey team, rolling the canary from 5% -> 15% now per the change window. Deploy Bot shows version v2.3.1 pinned.
Deploy Bot: [deploy-bot] canary bump started: service=redwood-infer, env=prod, from=5%, to=15%, version=v2.3.1, rollout_id=rl-8791
Ash: Quick ask — can someone check edge 5xx and kv-cache OOM dashboards? :eyes:
SRE Ops: Seeing a small uptick in 502s in eu-west over the last 2 mins, +0.9% absolute. Not huge but persistent. Suspect k-v cache pressure on subset of hosts.
Priya: If 502s correlate with increased latency we should hold. Can we pause and revert to 5% until we confirm? :hand: 
Liam: Pasted a quick tail of logs from affected pod:
```
2026-03-23T12:07:41Z ERROR http handler: write tcp conn reset
kvcache_evictions=1248 reclaim_failed=12
```
Maya: Thanks Liam. @Deploy Bot, please pause the rollout and pin traffic back to 5%. If possible open an incident if the rate doesn't drop in 5m.
Deploy Bot: [deploy-bot] action=pause_rollout rollout_id=rl-8791 new_percent=5% initiated_by=Maya status=accepting
Priya: I'll do a quick kcache config diff and check host memory. If we need an infra hotfix I'll prepare a small patch. Note: rollback_trigger=error_rate>1.5% per SLO.
Ash: Agreed. For release notes: add an entry that we paused the canary due to k-v cache pressure; follow-up will include root cause and remediation.
Maya: Consensus to hold and investigate. We'll reconvene in 10m unless metrics stabilize. :thumbsup:
